title: Cloud and Platform Engineer
description: For a renowned Swiss bank in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced cloud and platform engineer. You will provision and run platform services as code, depending on the team, with a focus on Entra ID automation, a data platform on Azure or a Kafka platform on Kubernetes. Your tasks Provision platform services with infrastructure as code, using Terraform, Helm and GitLab Automate build, test and release processes and run CI/CD pipelines Operate and develop Azure Kubernetes and storage accounts Depending on the team, automate Entra ID, build a data platform on Azure Postgres with lakehouse technologies, or upgrade Confluent Kafka on Kubernetes Your profile German at C1 level or higher, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected Very good Azure skills and experience with Kubernetes Infrastructure as code with Terraform DevOps toolchain with Git, GitLab, Docker and CI/CD Experience applying cloud security technologies Several years of experience at senior level Nice to have Go, Python or Bash OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect and Conditional Access Iceberg or Delta, Denodo Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
